questions.question: Which correction fixes: "Keep ASR imdependent of OMNI"?
options: A. Keep ASR independant of OMNI
B. Keep ASR independed of OMNI
C. Keep ASR independent of OMNI
D. Keep ASR imdependent of OMNI

questions.question: Which fixes: "but can they deloy in one http server?"
options: A. but can they deploy on one HTTP server?
B. but can they deploys in one http server?
C. but can they deloy in one http server?
D. but can they deployment in one http server?
questions.explanation: Use the verb "deploy"; "on one HTTP server" is clearer than "in" for a listening service.

questions.question: Which best fixes: "the llm request is forward to the cloud server"?
options: A. the llm request is forward to the cloud server
B. the LLM request forwarding to the cloud server
C. the LLM request are forwarded to the cloud server
D. the LLM request is forwarded to the cloud server
questions.explanation: Passive voice needs "is forwarded"; capitalize the acronym LLM.

questions.question: Which fixes: "Do they aotu-start with system?"
options: A. Does they auto-start with system?
B. Do they auto-start with the system?
C. Do they aotu-start with system?
D. Do they auto start with the system?
questions.explanation: Hyphenate "auto-start" as a verb; use "the system" and plural "Do they" for multiple services.

questions.question: Which fixes: "What will be deploymented on the rockchip board?"
options: A. What will deployment on the rockchip board?
B. What will be deploying on the Rockchip board?
C. What will be deployed on the Rockchip board?
D. What will be deploymented on the rockchip board?
questions.explanation: Use past participle "deployed" (not "deploymented"); capitalize the product name Rockchip.

questions.question: Which best fixes the redundant wording: "is the input image size is fixed 640x640?"
options: A. Is the input image size fixed at 640×640?
B. Is the input image sizes fixed 640x640?
C. Does the input image size is fixed 640x640?
D. is the input image size is fixed 640x640?
questions.explanation: Remove the duplicate "is"; use "fixed at" for a resolution constraint.

questions.question: Translate into natural technical English: "Qwen3-VL-4B 也给我一个同样格式的结果"
questions.modelAnswer: Give me the same format of results for Qwen3-VL-4B as well.
questions.explanation: "同样格式" means the same output layout or table structure as a prior model run.

questions.question: Translate into natural technical English: "Qwen2.5-Omni-3B 的数据有吗"
questions.modelAnswer: Do we have data for Qwen2.5-Omni-3B?
questions.explanation: A short benchmark-status question — "Do we have … data?" or "Is there data for …?" both work.

questions.question: Translate the user message in this API payload into English: "描述一下这张图片里的内容。"
questions.modelAnswer: Describe the content of this image.
questions.explanation: Vision/chat APIs often use a direct imperative: "Describe what is in this image" is equally natural.

questions.question: Improve this question about vision preprocessing: "Why does the engin always resize the image to 640×640?"
questions.modelAnswer: Why does the engine always resize the image to 640×640?
questions.explanation: Fix "engin" → "engine"; the rest is already clear for discussing YOLO-style letterboxing defaults.
